info.title: Native - Pnp (augmented)
info.description:
Cisco IOS XE Native Configuration — `/native/pnp` subtree, added to the /native root by sibling YANG module(s) via `augment "/ios:native"`. Origin module(s): Cisco-IOS-XE-pnp.

**Paths:** 12
**HTTP methods:** GET / PUT / PATCH / DELETE

get.description:
Retrieve GET container 'pnp' from the device via RESTCONF.

Returns the current operational or configuration state of this resource.

put.description:
Create or replace PUT container 'pnp' on the device.

This replaces the entire resource — any fields not included will be removed.

patch.description:
Partially update PATCH container 'pnp' on the device.

Only the fields included in the request body are modified; other fields remain unchanged.

delete.description:
Remove DELETE container 'pnp' from the device configuration.

This deletes the resource and all descendant data.
